_about: The NAME MAP between the English row ../legalese and this Hebrew-canonical row. Every identifier, section title and module name of the English row maps to exactly one Hebrew one. ../../source/twin-check.py applies this map to the English modules and requires the result to be token-for-token identical to the Hebrew modules (comments and herald text aside); check.sh applies its inverse to this row's run output and requires the Result blocks to be identical to the English row's. The English row is the oracle.

_source_codes.ordinance: the words are the Traffic Ordinance's own (פקודת התעבורה [נוסח חדש]), see source/traffic-ordinance.wiki, s.1, s.12A, s.62(3) or s.64B(a)
_source_codes.regulations: the words are the Traffic Regulations' own (תקנות התעבורה), see source/traffic-regulations.wiki, reg. 169A
_source_codes.composed: no counterpart in either instrument; coined here, and the note says why
